# Official CycloneDX schema fixtures

Vendored unchanged for offline tests. BOM 1.6 plus SPDX/JSF are from [CycloneDX specification tag 1.6](https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/tree/1.6/schema); BOM 1.5 is from [tag 1.5](https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/tree/1.5/schema), matching npm sbom output. The included LICENSE is Apache-2.0. Schema content is fixed in this repository; changes require deliberate review.
